question: What claim is made about the transmission concerning the earth-moving good-eaters and the agent by whom it was told?
premises: A teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters is posited.
That teaching was told by an earth-mover.
It is addressed to the beloved one.
inference: A transmission concerning the earth-moving good-eaters is presented as having been told by an earth-mover to the beloved one.
uncertainties: The specific content of that teaching is not given in this verse.
plain_english: Concerning the earth-moving good-eaters, it was told by an earth-mover, O beloved one.
